v0.1.0-alpha.1: First pre-release of collectarr-sync — the desktop-to-server synchronization service.
v0.1.0-alpha.2:
• Drops the legacy `storage_box` sync field in favor of the renamed `location` field, aligning with the core backend rename.
• README refreshed with updated configuration examples and field documentation.

### ✨ Features

**Storage Box → Location Rename (#4)**

• Removed `storage_box` from the sync payload; the `location` field is now the canonical storage identifier.
• Updated sync logic and configuration to reference `location` throughout.

**Documentation (#4)**

• README updated with current field names, configuration examples, and setup guidance.
